events.title: Prohibition Ends in the United States
events.description: Utah became the 36th state to ratify the Twenty-first Amendment, providing the three-fourths majority needed to repeal the Eighteenth Amendment and end nationwide Prohibition of alcohol that had begun in 1920.
events.significance: The repeal ended a 13-year national experiment that had fueled organized crime and widespread illegal trade, and it remains the only constitutional amendment ever repealed by another amendment.

events.title: Birth of Walt Disney
events.description: Walter Elias Disney was born in Chicago, Illinois. He went on to co-found the Walt Disney Company, create Mickey Mouse, and produce the first full-length cel-animated feature film, Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs (1937).
events.significance: Disney transformed animation and family entertainment, and his studio and theme parks became a global cultural and commercial force.

events.title: Death of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart
events.description: Mozart died in Vienna at the age of 35, leaving his Requiem unfinished. He had composed more than 600 works across virtually every musical genre of his time.
events.significance: Mozart is regarded as one of the greatest composers in Western music history, and his works continue to shape classical music performance and education.

events.title: Montgomery Bus Boycott Begins
events.description: Following the arrest of Rosa Parks on December 1, the Montgomery Bus Boycott began on this day, with African American residents refusing to ride city buses to protest racial segregation. The boycott was led by the newly formed Montgomery Improvement Association under Martin Luther King Jr.
events.significance: The 381-day boycott led to a Supreme Court ruling that bus segregation was unconstitutional and launched Martin Luther King Jr. as a national leader of the civil rights movement.

events.title: Columbus Reaches Hispaniola
events.description: Christopher Columbus landed on the island of Hispaniola, in what is now Haiti and the Dominican Republic, during his first voyage to the Americas.
events.significance: The landing led to the first lasting European settlements in the Americas and began the sustained colonization of the Caribbean.
